episodes.synopsis: Another of Akane's suitors, the quiet Gosunkugi, begins stalking Ranma to find the martial artist's weakness. Will he unearth Ranma's secret?
episodes.title: Ranma's Weakness

episodes.synopsis: Ranma's problems continue as he deals with the aftermath of his trance, Shampoo's new secret, her meddlesome great-grandmother and a jealous rival.
episodes.title: Attack of the Wild Mousse

episodes.synopsis: After a heated battle with Mousse, Ranma remains stuck in his female form and must master a difficult technique to obtain the antidote for his condition.
episodes.title: Chestnuts Roasting on an Open Fire

episodes.synopsis: Ranma follows the Cat Café to the beach, where a Martial Arts Watermelon Splitting Race stands in his way of finally retrieving the real Phoenix Pill.
episodes.title: Naval Engagement

episodes.synopsis: Cologne learns about the annual Martial Arts Delivery Race and signs Shampoo up to compete against Akane and Ranma. Who will reach the final goal first?
episodes.title: It's Fast or It's Free

episodes.synopsis: When the lecherous Happosai escapes to Nerima, seeking the disciples who imprisoned him, Akane and Ranma team up to deal with his perverted antics.
episodes.title: The Evil Wakes

episodes.synopsis: Shampoo receives a mysterious package. Meanwhile, Soun and Genma's plan to bring Ranma and Akane closer backfires when the real dojo destroyer shows up.
episodes.title: Instant Spring

episodes.synopsis: Ranma finds himself in a bind when he learns that the new transfer student is the person who attacked his father — and his long-lost childhood friend!
episodes.title: "Okonomiyaki" Means "I Love You"

episodes.synopsis: In order to be with Ranma, Ukyo hatches a scheme to help Ryoga get a date with Akane. Unfortunately, things don't go according to plan...
episodes.title: Love Letters in the Sauce

episodes.synopsis: After years cast in boyish roles, Akane finally gets to play her dream role: Juliet! But will the prospective Romeos' antics ruin her precious chance?
episodes.title: Not Your Typical Juliet

episodes.synopsis: Determined to win Shampoo back, Mousse challenges Ranma. He attacks using Spring of Drowned Duck water and traps Akane in a water tank.
episodes.title: Abduction of ...Akane?

episodes.synopsis: Despite Ranma's efforts to protect the audience from the cursed spring water, Akane gets doused instead. What emerges is not his fiancée, but a duck.
episodes.title: Fowl Play
